claim: all Section 77 gates are inventoried and mapped to xtask subcommands or explicit blockers
test_gate_list_exhaustive enumerates all 28 Section 77 gates and asserts each has wrapper or blocker
all 6 ai-fast gates (fmt, check, clippy, nextest, forbidden-scan, hotpath-scan) have match arms in Commands enum
all 4 ai-deep gates (miri, mutants, llvm-cov, fuzz-build) have match arms in Commands enum

all 11 ai-release gates (check, test, supply-chain, miri, fuzz-smoke, coverage, mutants-smoke, bench-build, feature-powerset, source-length, maxperf) have match arms in Commands enum or delegate to moon/just
GateEvidence struct has all required fields (kind, gate_name, command, exit_code, log, status, why_failed) and round-trips through serde_yaml
explain_failure populates why_failed.hint and why_failed.repair_command for failed gates
evidence output goes to .evidence/<bead-id>/ when --bead flag is provided
checker: XBEAK_ID=vb-test cargo xtask ai-fast --bead vb-test 2>&1 && test -f .evidence/vb-test/*.yaml

claim: ai-fast, ai-deep, ai-release profile commands aggregate evidence into a single YAML document
exit code 0 when all gates pass; exit code 1 when any gate fails or evidence missing
checker: cargo xtask ai-fast && echo PASS || echo FAIL; cargo xtask ai-fast --gate broken && echo PASS2 || echo FAIL2

claim: --bead flag propagates through profile runner to evidence path construction
missing evidence file causes profile runner to exit with failure, never silent pass
validate_evidence_dir returns MissingEvidence error for absent evidence files
gate timeouts are enforced; no unbounded loops in gate runner
identical gate evidence serializes to bit-identical YAML across two runs with fixed seed
no panic!, unwrap!, expect! in xtask evidence or gate modules
all fallible functions in evidence module return Result<T, Error>
stdout contains only YAML; raw tool output is redirected to log files
checker: cargo xtask ai-fast 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo {} | cargo xtask parse_yaml 2>/dev/null'

claim: ai-fast, ai-deep, ai-release commands require no interactive input and have default values for all flags
checker: run all three profile commands in a non-interactive shell with no tty

claim: GateTimeout error is constructed when gate duration exceeds configured timeout
GateFailed error propagates exit_code and log path from failed subprocess
MissingEvidence is returned when evidence file does not exist in validate_evidence_dir
EvidenceWriteFailed is returned when YAML file cannot be written
SubcommandNotFound error is returned for unknown Commands variants
BeadDirectoryCreationFailed is returned when .evidence/<bead> dir cannot be created
YamlSerializationFailed is returned when serde_yaml fails on evidence serialization
UpstreamMoonFailed propagates moon task name and inner error
checker: cargo xtask ai-release --profile moon-fail 2>&1 | grep UpstreamMoonFailed

claim: UpstreamJustFailed propagates just recipe name and inner error
checker: cargo xtask ai-release --profile just-fail 2>&1 | grep UpstreamJustFailed

claim: arbitrary YAML bytes do not cause panic on GateEvidence deserialization
all xtask evidence and gate modules achieve >80% line/branch coverage
